dimension.category_description: When assistance appears and who triggers it: system-initiated, continuous, deferred, session-bound, or explicitly summoned.
dimension.classification_boundary: The timing or trigger must be observable in the interaction; surface placement alone belongs to U09.

candidates.title: CatAlyst: Domain-Extensible Intervention for Preventing Task Procrastination Using Large Generative Models
candidates.why: CatAlyst exposes the complete proactive-support structure: it detects halted task progress without a user request and responds by presenting a generated continuation of the user’s work. The state trigger, unsolicited output, and actionable intervention are all explicit, while the domain-extensible design makes the mechanism broadly reusable.
candidates.over_the_runner_up: CatAlyst ranks above ProMemAssist because it turns detected difficulty directly into substantive task continuation, whereas ProMemAssist’s evidence establishes a strong timing policy but says less about the assistance content and its practical effect.
candidates.pattern_summary: Output is emitted without a user request immediately preceding it.
candidates.structural_signature: An output-producing edge in the control graph whose predecessor is not a user event: a clock, a state-change condition, or an internal decision step. There is no request object attributable to the user for that output, and the interface offers no control the user could have withheld to prevent it appearing at that moment.
candidates.pattern_curator_notes: The final three preserve the consensus order; no candidate was moved into or out of the top three. The main judgment was to retain rid 3819 over rid 5473 because rid 3819’s figure evidence shows the full observable structure—an internally inferred need followed by a specific popup—while rid 5473’s abstract establishes triggering but leaves the signals and presentation underspecified. No score was adjusted by more than 0.3. Readers should distrust strong claims about measured impact: the supplied excerpts primarily establish mechanisms, not outcomes. Evidence for rid 3819 is especially narrow because it comes from a figure caption, while the CatAlyst and ProMemAssist excerpts do not independently establish how reliably their triggers work or whether users welcomed the interventions.

candidates.over_the_runner_up: ProMemAssist ranks above the meeting-reflection system because its immediate-deliver, defer, or discard policy captures the broader design problem of deciding whether and when proactive support should appear.

candidates.title: Visual Captions: Augmenting Verbal Communication with On-the-fly Visuals
candidates.why: Visual content is generated synchronously with an independently unfolding verbal exchange, so each caption must appear while its corresponding utterance remains current.
candidates.over_the_runner_up: It outranks GestureCoach because it expresses the pattern in its most general form—synchronizing heterogeneous outputs to live communication—rather than one specialized coaching intervention.
candidates.pattern_summary: The system emits its output in step with an activity that is unfolding independently — a conversation, a performance, a learning session, a walk through an environment — so that each output appears at the moment its referent occurs.
candidates.structural_signature: An input stream is consumed continuously and each produced item is scheduled against a timestamp in that stream; the pipeline is held to a latency budget so that the item is presented while its referent is still current. There is no batch boundary between the activity and the output — the activity does not have to end for output to appear.
candidates.pattern_curator_notes: I departed from the consensus by excluding its second-ranked candidate, Graphologue (rid 13531), and promoting GestureCoach and StoryDrawer. Although Graphologue strongly demonstrates incremental, no-batch stream processing, its referent is the system’s own GPT-4 response rather than the independently unfolding conversation, performance, learning session, or environmental activity required by the definition. GestureCoach was slightly increased from 4.40 to 4.50 because its quote provides the clearest structural evidence: continuously tracked speech, proactive cues, and delivery during rehearsal. No adjustment exceeds 0.3. Readers should distrust implementation-level certainty across all three picks: the supplied excerpts establish synchronicity or real-time behavior but do not document timestamp assignment, latency budgets, segmentation granularity, or measured end-to-end delay.

candidates.title: Beyond Text Generation: Supporting Writers with Continuous Automatic Text Summaries
candidates.why: Continuously recomputed paragraph summaries appear as margin annotations beside the text being authored, making the source, automatic derivation, adjacency, and non-committal commentary role explicit.
candidates.over_the_runner_up: It is more canonical than GPTFootprint because the adjacent output is unmistakably generated commentary on the artifact, rather than a display of calculated usage metrics.
candidates.pattern_summary: A persistent region sits beside the surface the user is working on and shows generated content derived from that surface's current state.
candidates.structural_signature: Two co-present regions with an asymmetric dependency: region A holds the user-authored state, region B renders a derived generation, and B is recomputed as a side effect of changes to A with no invocation step. B is typically read-only or non-committal — its content does not enter the artifact unless the user acts. The adjacency is spatial (margin, sidebar, docked panel) so that A and B are read together.
candidates.pattern_curator_notes: The final selection retains the consensus top three, but Marco’s score is reduced slightly because the quoted evidence does not explicitly establish persistent spatial adjacency or read-only status. The strongest two picks have direct evidence for placement and live updating; however, GPTFootprint’s output is calculated telemetry rather than generative prose, so readers should treat it as a structural exemplar rather than a prototypical content-generation case. Marco is the least secure pick: its automatic cross-view derivation is clear, but co-presence is inferred from the named views rather than demonstrated by the quote. Plotania was not promoted despite its novelty because its evidence does not establish the authored source, automatic edit-to-refresh dependency, or side-panel placement; DiagLink was not promoted because its right-hand display may be a structured record of collected information rather than running generated commentary.

candidates.title: Prompting Destiny: Negotiating Socialization and Growth in an LLM-Mediated Speculative Gameworld
candidates.why: The system explicitly suppresses real-time evaluation during play and releases feedback only at the end-of-stage boundary, with a stated rationale—reducing score-chasing—for choosing deferral over continuous intervention.
candidates.over_the_runner_up: Unlike TeamVision, this paper explicitly establishes both deliberate withholding during the activity and release at a defined boundary, rather than merely locating a dashboard after the activity.
candidates.pattern_summary: The system detects something during an ongoing activity but withholds any response until the activity has ended, then presents its findings and the user's controls in a dedicated step.
candidates.structural_signature: Two phases: during phase one the system observes and accumulates without emitting anything to the user; on the terminating event of phase one, phase two opens with the accumulated findings and a set of controls that act retroactively on phase-one material. Nothing the system produces is visible before the boundary, and phase-two actions can revise what phase one produced. Transplants to editing, driving, code review, form filling — anywhere an assist could have fired mid-stream.
candidates.pattern_curator_notes: The consensus ordering is retained, but all three scores are reduced because none fully demonstrates the complete structural signature, especially findings paired with controls that retroactively revise phase-one material. PRISM receives the largest adjustment, from 2.40 to 2.10, because one rater’s structural disqualification is persuasive: post-task reflection alone is not deferred intervention. Readers should distrust any inference beyond the quoted evidence: 9513 is supported only by an abstract excerpt, TeamVision only by a brief abstract statement, and PRISM only by a figure caption. TeamVision’s silent accumulation is inferred rather than shown, while PRISM’s during-task detection is not evidenced at all. The fourth candidate was excluded because it solicits feedback after the meeting rather than revealing an intervention generated and withheld during it.

candidates.title: StorySage: Conversational Autobiography Writing Powered by a Multi-Agent Framework
candidates.why: StorySage is the strongest structural match because it explicitly defines its depicted interaction flow as one session, indicating that autobiographical conversation is organized as a bounded episode rather than an always-open thread. The available excerpt does not establish the session’s entry condition, terminal state, or cross-session reference rules, so the exemplar is strong but incompletely evidenced.
candidates.over_the_runner_up: StorySage ranks above Poet-Weaver because its evidence explicitly says the flow defines a single session, whereas Poet-Weaver’s caption merely labels a flow as being for a reflection session.
candidates.pattern_summary: Rather than an always-on stream, the system packages interaction into episodes with a defined opening and close.
candidates.structural_signature: Control flow is a repeated cycle with an entry condition and a terminal state: material is admitted at session start, processed through a fixed internal flow, and the session closes, after which no further turns belong to it. Session boundaries are visible as flow-diagram endpoints and as scoping for what the system may reference. Transplants to any continuous process that could have been left running — monitoring, tutoring, journaling, review.
candidates.pattern_curator_notes: I retained the consensus ordering and excluded StayFocused. Its evidence describes sessions set by users, which directly conflicts with the definition’s system-imposed boundary and resembles a focus timer more than a bounded interaction flow. I reduced Poet-Weaver from 2.43 to 2.25 and HINT from 1.83 to 1.55 because neither excerpt confirms the required terminal state or session-scoped reference behavior; neither adjustment exceeds 0.3. Readers should treat Poet-Weaver and especially HINT as provisional exemplars: their evidence names sessions but does not expose the complete structural signature. StorySage is the only selection whose excerpt directly says that a flow defines one session, though even it lacks evidence for opening, closure, repetition, and cross-session scoping.

candidates.title: Choice Over Control: How Users Write with Large Language Models using Diegetic and Non-Diegetic Prompting
candidates.why: This is the most complete structural match: pressing Tab explicitly requests generation, and the suggestion appears after the current caret in the same text editor.
candidates.over_the_runner_up: Unlike HiLDE, its evidence directly states both the user-fired control and the caret-relative placement of the resulting suggestion.
candidates.pattern_summary: A generated continuation is produced at the user's current position in the artifact being edited, and only when the user fires a control to ask for it.
candidates.structural_signature: A single user-triggered control whose output is inserted at the current insertion point of the same editable surface. There is no separate request window and no navigation step; when the control is not fired, nothing is generated, so the output's position and timing are both determined by the user's cursor and keystroke.
candidates.pattern_curator_notes: I reversed the top two consensus candidates: rid 2002 ranks first because its quote directly establishes every critical structural element—explicit invocation, current-caret placement, and the same editing surface—while rid 14006 only strongly implies same-surface cursor-relative insertion. Otherwise, the selected set follows the consensus top three, and no score adjustment exceeds 0.3. Readers should distrust the exact insertion semantics for HiLDE because they are implied rather than stated verbatim. FigurA11y is the weakest inclusion: its figure caption names Generate at Cursor and locates it in the authoring workflow, but does not explicitly describe the activating gesture, whether generation occurs only on request, or how text is committed.
